description: Docs gap: POST /zones/{zone_id}/api_gateway/user_schemas is a multipart upload — schema file bytes under a part named `file`, plus `kind`, `name`, `validation_enabled` parts — but the docs model it as a bare JSON POST with no body members, so the live API rejects it with BadRequest. Transcribed from the distilled SDK's createUserSchema. `file` is a plain body member (not formDataFile) so the multipart encoder appends it under the member name, which is what the API expects.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: Schema file bytes (File/Blob), sent as the multipart `file` part.
Flag whether schema is enabled for validation.
